sn22.61:1.1: Tatra || voca || || Rūpam bhikkhave ādittam || vedanā ādittā || saññā ādittā || saṅkhārā ādittā || viññāṇam ādittam || || Evam passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako rūpasmiṃ nibbindati || vedanāya pi || saññāya pi || saṅkhāresu pi || viññāṇasmim pi nibbindati || nibbindaṃ virajjati virāgā vimuccati vimuttasmim vimuttam iti ñāṇaṃ hoti || || Khīṇā jāti vusitam brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || ||
